name: security-scanner-mcp
description: Tools for automated host security audits, listening port scans, dependency vulnerability checks, and finding schema validations.

tools.name: audit_host_security
tools.description: Audits Linux host OS security: SSH configuration, firewall status, and intrusion prevention service alignment.

checks.description: List of specific host checks to execute.

tools.name: audit_listening_ports
tools.description: Scans active listening network sockets and compares them against firewall allowlists.

tools.name: validate_audit_findings
tools.description: Validates findings.json and coverage-ledger.json against the canonical Cloudflare security audit report schema.

findings_path.description: Absolute or relative path to the findings.json file.

ledger_path.description: Optional path to the coverage-ledger.json file.

tools.name: scan_dependency_vulnerabilities
tools.description: Audits project dependency manifests (package.json, requirements.txt, go.mod) for CVEs.

manifest_path.description: Path to the dependency manifest or lockfile.
